notes: Two distinct active listings compared side-by-side in one email. Correct = 2 opportunities. Watch for merging into 1 or splitting into more than 2.

input.subject: Two Battery Park City Options to Weigh — 2BR/2BA
input.bodyText:
Hi Jordan,

Following up from our call — here are the two comparable Battery Park City options I'd have you weigh. Both are 2BR/2BA, both active now.

OPTION A — 225 Rector Pl #12F
- 2BR / 2BA
- $1,450,000
- Northern exposure, softer light, more traditional split layout
- Lower common charges

OPTION B — 70 Little West St #18G
- 2BR / 2BA
- $1,520,000
- Higher floor with brighter western light, open river-adjacent views
- More open-plan living/kitchen, slightly higher common charges

Quick take: A is the value play with the lower carrying cost; B is the light-and-views play with the more modern layout. Happy to set up back-to-back showings so you can feel the difference in person.

Let me know which direction pulls you.

Best,
Priya Nandakumar
Corcoran
